value.rationale: The source literature already counts general-position vertex sets but does not determine their topological or full integral symmetry representation. This natural invariant distinguishes mixed circle/top-sphere degrees and resolves all integral orientation signs under within-part permutations and part exchanges. These modules are stronger than face enumerators, Betti numbers, or rational characters, and uniformly cover every complete multipartite graph including singleton parts and the bipartite exceptional action. The conceptual gap is motivated by the 2026 multipartite general-position polynomial and its full graph symmetries.
